scoring_justification: Recomputing the full analytical model in the verifier is infeasible. Agent's CSV end-of-life stress values are compared to paper-reported gold from hybrid model curves with generous tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference radial stress at IL/Al interface at end-of-life fission densities for six plate-location configurations, extracted from paper's Fig. 12 and Fig. 13 hybrid model curves.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper figures 12 and 13 showing hybrid model stress vs. fission density; digitized by approximating from published plots.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Visual interpolation from figure curves at end-of-life fission densities given in Table 2.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly traceable to paper-reported results plotted in the referenced figures.

outputs.description: Radial stress at the IL/Al interface as a function of fission density for the six plate/location cases. Checker compares end-of-life values and a sign-transition trend to hidden paper gold with tolerance.

output_contract.notes: Only the CSV is scored. The process step evidence (data_loaded.txt) is not verified. The checker uses hidden gold end-of-life values and a trend check for V6022M location B stress sign transition.

steps.description: Compare radial stress at end-of-life fission density for six configurations to paper gold with tolerance.
Verify that for V6022M location B, radial stress changes from compressive to tensile between FD 2.0 and 3.0.
